run: correct --uni UNI.nii.gz --inv2 INV2.nii.gz --b1 B1.nii.gz --b1-type tfl --mp2rage TR,TI1,TI2,FA1,FA2,NZ1,NZ2,TRFLASH,EFF results

notes: Denoise UNI with the same executable:
easy-mp2rage denoise --uni UNI.nii.gz --inv1 INV1.nii.gz --inv2 INV2.nii.gz results
No network connection is required. Add --help for every option.
Inputs are NIfTI. DICOM import and BIDS batches need the web app.
Easy MP2RAGE is research software. Check the maps and parameters before use.
Please cite Marques et al. 2010 (NeuroImage), Marques and Gruetter 2013
(PLoS ONE), Eggenschwiler et al. 2012 (MRM) and O'Brien et al. 2014 (PLoS ONE).
